executiveSummary: Iteration 000002 is substantially compliant with the PRD. All eight user stories and seven of eight functional requirements are fully implemented. The full job lifecycle (pending → running → succeeded/failed) is operational across the gateway (Bun/Elysia) and stub worker (FastAPI), with p-queue concurrency control, SSE streaming, in-memory job store, automated test suites, and smoke-test documentation all in place. Two minor gaps were identified: (1) FR-7 requires the worker's simulated delay to be configurable via an environment variable, but the implementation hardcodes INFER_DELAY_SECONDS = 2 as a Python constant rather than reading it from the environment; (2) three automated tests (2 gateway, 1 worker) fail due to a case-sensitivity mismatch between README text and test assertions, causing US-008-AC04 to be unsatisfied.

verificationByFR.notes: All four gateway endpoints are present: POST /v1/jobs (jobs.ts:86-112), GET /v1/jobs/:id (jobs.ts:66-85), GET /v1/jobs/:id/events (jobs.ts:14-65), POST /worker/done (worker.ts:5-36).
Four states (pending, running, succeeded, failed) are defined in job-store.ts:4. Transitions are one-way and enforced in updateJob (job-store.ts:39-52).
In-memory store implemented as Map<string, Job> in job-store.ts:17. No external database dependency.
PQueue({ concurrency: 1 }) instantiated at module scope in queue.ts:6, shared across the gateway process lifetime.
Worker reads GATEWAY_CALLBACK_URL from environment with default http://localhost:3000 (tasks.py:19). Documented in worker/.env.example.
Gateway reads WORKER_BASE_URL from environment with default http://localhost:8000 (queue.ts:9). Documented in gateway/.env.example.

The stub worker applies a fixed 2 s delay (tasks.py:11) as required. However, the delay is a hardcoded Python constant (INFER_DELAY_SECONDS = 2) rather than read from an environment variable. FR-7 explicitly requires the delay to be configurable via env var.
SSE stream closes immediately after emitting the terminal event (routes/jobs.ts:32). Client disconnect is handled via the ReadableStream cancel callback (routes/jobs.ts:51-53).

verificationByUS.notes: All five ACs satisfied. POST /v1/jobs accepts {type, params}, assigns UUID, stores pending state, returns 201 {jobId}, and returns 400 on bad/missing body. Covered by jobs-create.test.ts (7 tests passing).

All five ACs satisfied. p-queue concurrency:1 verified; gateway POSTs {id, type, params} to /infer; 202 → running transition; unreachable worker → failed with error message. Covered by jobs-queue.test.ts (6 tests passing).

All five ACs satisfied. GET /v1/jobs/:id returns {id, status, createdAt, updatedAt}, conditionally includes url (success) and error (failure), and returns 404 for unknown ids. Covered by jobs-get.test.ts (4 tests passing).

All six ACs satisfied. SSE endpoint opens text/event-stream, emits terminal events, closes stream immediately after, handles late-connecting clients, and returns 404 for unknown ids. Covered by jobs-sse.test.ts (7 tests passing).

All six ACs satisfied. POST /infer validates via Pydantic InferRequest model, returns 202 immediately, background task delays 2 s then POSTs to gateway, errors are caught and logged without crashing, GET /health returns 200 during background work. Covered by test_us005_infer.py (7 tests passing).

All five ACs satisfied. POST /worker/done accepts {id, url}, updates job to succeeded with url and refreshed updatedAt, emits SSE event to subscribers, returns 404 for unknown ids. Covered by us006.test.ts (5 tests passing).

Both ACs satisfied. docs/smoke-test.md provides detailed step-by-step instructions (start gateway, start worker, POST job, open SSE stream, observe completion, GET final status) with expected outputs and lifecycle table.

ACs 01, 02, 03, 05 are satisfied. AC04 ('all tests pass with bun test and uv run pytest') is not satisfied: 3 tests fail (gateway/src/us005.test.ts:23 and worker/tests/test_us005.py:41) because they assert the README contains 'not a phase 1 package dependency' (lowercase) but the README text uses 'Phase 1' (capitalized). This is a test-assertion mismatch, not an implementation defect, but it still causes a CI failure.

minorObservations: Worker asset URL is hardcoded as 'http://localhost/assets/<id>.png' (tasks.py:18). For real deployment this placeholder URL format should be configurable or replaced by actual asset storage logic.

The gateway .env.example mentions GATEWAY_PUBLIC_URL and INTERNAL_CALLBACK_SECRET as 'later phase' variables, but neither is implemented or validated yet. This is acceptable for Phase 2 but should be tracked.

Test files us005.test.ts (gateway) and test_us005.py (worker) assert exact README text in lowercase; the README uses title case ('Phase 1'). Fix by updating the test assertions to use case-insensitive matching or aligning README capitalization.
conclusionsAndRecommendations: The implementation is of high quality and covers all critical paths end-to-end. Two items require remediation before the iteration can be considered fully compliant: (1) Read INFER_DELAY_SECONDS from an environment variable in tasks.py (e.g. os.getenv('INFER_DELAY_SECONDS', '2')) to satisfy FR-7; (2) Fix the three failing tests by switching to case-insensitive assertion or updating the README to use lowercase 'phase 1' to satisfy US-008-AC04. The hardcoded asset URL placeholder is acceptable for this stub phase but should be noted as technical debt for Phase 3.
